response.sql:
SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_large_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count
FROM trans
WHERE amount >= 2400
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY large_transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: If “above 2400” is intended to exclude transactions equal to the cutoff, use a strict cutoff.
